samplePlan.note: milestone method: 3 independent runs per decision row, extended one run at a time to 10 (F7 to 5) only while a hard row is undecided; 60 pointer inputs; 10 Undo/Redo cycles; 20 F13 edits over ten measured cycles; F2 cold+warm; F7 warm; full E5 matrix; no A.6 or delayed-preview proof (Bench 1 evidence)

rows.workload: S fixture, one typed edit, Save to the local test-auth stack
limitations: S06 milestone method: decision rows start at 3 independent runs and extend one run at a time (to 10, F7 to 5) only while a hard row is undecided; every run must hold 25 % headroom to pass, and every run must breach the budget to fail early

actual plan: F3 warm 3 runs (+7 bound), cold/repeat-use 1 check each; F2 3 runs per state; F7 3 warm runs (+2 bound); F13 20 edits per measured cycle at cold 10, warm 1, repeat-use 10 cycles; 2 drag + 2 precision samples and 10 Undo/Redo cycles per run

decision bands: warm F3/F4/F8; F2 cold+warm at S/M; F7 warm at S/M; F13 cold/repeat-use 10-cycle growth. Single-run cold/repeat-use interaction rows and Target rows (F2 L, F7 L) are recorded checks, not statistical gates
not run: A.6 old-method rows and the delayed-preview proof (Bench 1 evidence), F2 repeat-use, F7 cold/repeat-use, grid-XL, realistic-L and sweep latency rows (report-only, deferred)
S06 milestone acceptance only: a small-sample p95 is not a rare-tail estimate, and this is not production-scale, grid-XL, or ultimate geometry/rendering certification
hard budgets require the designated reference machine and its recorded conditions
save-status DOM updates are not paint/presentation timestamps and cannot establish the contract's presented-local-feedback gate
local loopback test API under the configured CDP network profile; no production-service baseline and the durable-receipt target formula is not accepted here
main-thread work during Save is not split out by this pass
